title: Persist the exact Foundation attempt context manifest
description: Prerequisite for task-af9454f4438242e5854208284e0086e2. Current measurement at HEAD a42ae2f: @moe/context exports renderContext/digestContextManifest/createReleaseHandoff, but apps/daemon has no @moe/context manifest edge and no production attempt contextManifestDigest. A release handoff cannot hash a caller digest or reconstruct one after launch. Deliverable: on the real Foundation attempt/context assembly path, record the exact rendered context manifest and digest immediately before provider invocation, bound to durable project/session/node/attempt, current graph/configuration and sealed input manifest; expose strict readback. Hard-depend on task-a3e8a02d's server-derived attempt input/launch authority. Consumer: task-af9454f4438242e5854208284e0086e2.
definitionOfDone: The production Foundation launch/context path uses public `@moe/context` rendering and `digestContextManifest` over the exact bytes delivered, then durably records the manifest/digest before any provider effect; it does not hash caller argv, a ref string, or reconstructed bytes.

The record binds projectId, sessionId, nodeKey, attemptRef, current graph revision/hash/epoch, configuration digest and sealed input-manifest digest, and a strict reader rejects any cross-binding mismatch.
Absent, stale, foreign, malformed, noncanonical, ambiguous and unreadable context records return distinct stable codes with exact layers; no UNKNOWN value is replaced by a fabricated digest.

Exact replay returns the original bytes with unchanged raw event/decision counts; conflicting context bytes under one identity refuse before provider invocation and leave zero partial launch/record residue.

Real-Sqlite tests drive the production pre-launch call site, assert exact code/layer, positive hostile-case counts, one accepted control and a mutation where hashing a reference instead of delivered bytes reddens a named assertion.

apps/daemon package.json and pnpm-lock declare @moe/context and a compiled bare-root import probe typechecks; completion names task-af9454f4438242e5854208284e0086e2 as consumer and daemon tests report nonzero counts.
taskRails: Hard-depend on task-a3e8a02ddb864c689ac66de7b66bfceb; do not reconstruct context until that task owns the server-derived launch/input bytes.
Use only public @moe/context roots and verify manifest, lock importer and compiled bare-specifier edge; no deep imports or local digest implementation.
No caller context bytes/digest/ref become authority and no provider launch occurs before the durable context decision.
TDD exact codes/layers, real SqliteEventStore, target <=250 lines per production source, explicit owned-path commits.
blockedReason: Fresh measurement at committed HEAD 15918c7 shows the described hard dependency is both BLOCKED and insufficient. task-a3e8 promises final launchTemplate/inputManifest but no AdmittedContextSelection, graph/config/context provenance, trusted context budget, or typed rendered-bytes delivery slot. Repo-wide production search finds zero selectContext/renderContext caller; daemon has no @moe/context manifest/lock edge (plain Node from apps/daemon => ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND); Foundation forwards flat argv unchanged and Claude physical boundary has no context/stdin field; no context record/codec/reader exists. Therefore task-203 cannot prove exact delivered bytes without inventing context items or guessing/mutating argv. SPIDR prerequisites filed: task-c7f2530b4a4445398a5e572f0568ea1d (dependency edge), task-c320c34a848341838685e338db089262 (server-derived selection authority; must get human/facts decision), task-3e891741bef14097bbed6d820b392f98 (strict record codec), task-22fa35a59f204777b4db56f7516ef57b (separate prelaunch ledger), task-225d25f7e58a401b8b414dd69ef3ab60 (strict reader), task-933605a5f6ef436cb68f0ec0a2fdc755 (exact prelaunch delivery composition). Re-plan this parent only after those and a3e8 are DONE; then keep it as the <=3-file real Foundation service/physical-boundary/replay hardening slice. Do not add context events to the existing Foundation dispatch aggregate or grow the 248-line service materially.
